北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京朋友，晴好但风大干燥，注意补水和防风保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, sunny but windy and dry. Stay hydrated and warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪朋友，多云微凉，出门别忘了添件外套，注意保暖。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi friends, it's cloudy and cool. Don't forget a jacket when going out!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海朋友，阴天有点冷，出门记得多穿点，小心着凉。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai friends, it's overcast and chilly. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州朋友，天气宜人多云，湿度高，注意清爽防潮。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou friends, pleasant cloudy weather. High humidity, stay fresh and mindful of dampness.
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳朋友，多云微风，体感舒适。别忘了带伞哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen friends, cloudy with a light breeze, feels comfortable. Don't forget an umbrella!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州朋友，阴天微凉，记得添衣保暖，照顾好自己。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou friends, it's overcast and cool. Remember to add layers and take care.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京朋友，阴天体感稍冷，注意保暖，别冻着了。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing friends, overcast and feeling a bit cold. Stay warm!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都朋友，阴天湿度高，出门记得带伞，注意防潮。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu friends, overcast and very humid. Remember an umbrella and stay dry.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉朋友，大雾天气，能见度低，出行请注意安全！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan friends, foggy weather, low visibility. Please travel safely!
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安朋友，阴冷潮湿，记得多穿衣，别忘了防寒。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an friends, overcast, cold and damp. Remember to dress warmly to prevent cold.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆朋友，阴天湿度大，体感舒适。出行带把伞吧。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing friends, overcast and humid, feels comfortable. Take an umbrella.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨朋友，寒意十足，请务必多穿厚衣，注意防寒保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin friends, it's very cold! Please dress in thick layers to stay warm.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳朋友，体感温度低，出门多添衣，别着凉了。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang friends, the feels-like temperature is low. Dress warmly!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明朋友，多云天气，温度适宜，享受这好时光吧！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming friends, cloudy weather with pleasant temperatures. Enjoy your day!
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门朋友，晴好但有风，记得保暖，紫外线也要注意哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen friends, sunny but windy. Stay warm and mind the UV.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛朋友，阴冷体感冻人，多穿点，照顾好自己。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao friends, overcast and freezing cold. Dress warmly and take care.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连朋友，雾天寒冷，能见度低，出行务必注意安全。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian friends, foggy and cold with low visibility. Please travel safely.
大连.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃
